Enjoy the beautiful track Noor E Khuda from My Name is Khan, now in stunning 8K/4K resolution. This soulful track, composed by Shankar Ehsaan Loy, features the magical vocals of Adnan Sami, Shankar Mahadevan & Shreya Ghoshal. With Shahrukh Khan and Kajol delivering powerful performances, this song explores themes of love, faith, and hope.
Song Name - Noor E Khuda
Movie - My Name is Khan
Singer - Adnan Sami, Shankar Mahadevan & Shreya Ghoshal
Composer - Shankar Ehsaan Loy
Lyricists - Niranjan Iyengar
